title: Erasing a project leaves its memory keys in sleep journals and conflict copies
before: journal lines, cycle_report FTS row and .peer/conflicts copies keep the erased space
after: lines naming the space or an erased id redacted and re-indexed; conflict copies removed

title: This PC's gate trusts its latest reading at any age
